comparator.sourceNotes: The 2026–2027 Enschede curriculum comprises 45 required units worth 150 EC and two 15 EC minor positions. The programme’s current-student table and accompanying 10 July PDF agree on the names, placements and credits of Machine Elements and Project Product Design, but give different identifiers from the regulations. The internal component identifiers follow the programme table.

exception.reason: The feasible UCR candidates provide substantial contributions in product prototyping and testing, robot kinematics and manipulation, linear systems and renewable-energy assessment. They do not sustain the target’s combination of physical mechanics, thermal and fluid analysis, materials and manufacturing across successive engineering projects.
exception.curriculumContext: The 180 EC Enschede curriculum is verified against the current 2026–2027 curriculum, official plan and programme regulations. The 150 EC compulsory programme includes the 12 EC research and 3 EC societal embedding units. Two positions cover 30 EC of minor study.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Consumer Product Design covers working mechanisms, prototyping, testing and production considerations. Robotics covers kinematics, motion planning, and grasping with force closure. Linear Systems covers mathematical representations and control applications. Sustainability Essentials covers thermodynamics, stress and strain, and materials as scientific foundations. Energy & Sustainability and Renewable System Design add resource, technology, system and partner-facing design assessment. Life Cycle Analysis & Circular Economy adds product and process impact assessment. Living with Water adds applied water management. The combinations lack sustained engineering analysis of loads, material deformation, thermal cycles, fluid flow, manufacturing processes and their integration through successive laboratory and design projects. The planning evidence supports the two test compositions and does not determine the substantive disposition.

candidateAssessment.concept: Physical structures, mechanical design, materials and manufacturing
candidateAssessment.assessment: The feasible design and modelling candidate includes working-mechanism prototypes, robotic kinematics and force closure, feedback and signals, and introductory stress and strain. The available combination falls short of sustained force and deformation analysis, engineering materials selection and manufacturing across dedicated projects.

The feasible energy and sustainable technology candidate includes energy demand and supply, storage, resource and material recovery, product and process life cycles, sustainable water management and a partner report. It does not develop or repeatedly apply thermodynamic cycle, heat transfer and fluid mechanics analysis.

audience.programmeDescription: This English-taught degree in Enschede studies how machines, structures and energy systems work and how to design and improve them. Students apply mechanics, thermodynamics, materials science and manufacturing in a sequence of projects. The degree includes 30 EC of minor study and a final research assignment with a separate study of its societal implications.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers related study in product prototyping, robot motion, mathematical modelling and renewable energy system design. Twente develops these interests through a sustained sequence in mechanics, heat and fluid flow, materials and manufacturing. Its projects apply that sequence to machines, structures and energy systems. UCR’s available courses offer individual points of overlap, with insufficient coverage of that sequence for a comparable programme.

curriculum.limitation: The minor occupies 30 EC in the first half of year three. The final assignment comprises 12 EC of research and 3 EC on societal implications.

componentNotes.me-ut-202300053: 4-EC part of the mechanical-tool project; a further 1 EC continues in the next module.
componentNotes.me-ut-202000112: 1-EC continuation of the mechanical-tool project, separately credited in module 2.
componentNotes.me-ut-approved-free-choice-space: To start the minor, students need 90 EC, including 52 EC from year one, and may have at most 4.5 EC of unfinished courses that run in the same quarter.
componentNotes.me-ut-approved-free-choice-space-2: The two positions form 30 EC of minor study. A self-designed minor requires prior Examination Board approval.
componentNotes.me-ut-202000154: Students begin the compulsory research assignment after their supervisor passes the proposal.
componentNotes.me-ut-202000155: Compulsory assessment of the research project’s societal implications.
componentNotes.me-ut-202000145: Entry requires a pass in Dynamics 1 or System Analysis and no more than one resit from module 4.
componentNotes.me-ut-202000150: Entry requires completion of year one, 26 EC across modules 5 and 6, 11.5 EC in module 7 and 8.5 EC in module 8.
